name: Lwówek Śląski County (Poland)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of yellow over red, charged at the centre with the county arms of Lwówek Śląski: a shield divided by a bend with a yellow lion on red and a black eagle on yellow.
history: Polish county (powiat) and city flags are established by resolution of the council under the Act on Badges and Uniforms, normally after an opinion of the Heraldic Commission; the flag takes the colours of the arms.
